protocol_meta.target_scope: HTTP/1.1 server subset for planning-agent debugging

channels.name: main
channels.purpose: 每个 accepted TCP connection 承载 HTTP request bytes 和 HTTP response bytes；当前实现每个响应后关闭连接。

runtime_implications.summary: network 层使用 nonblocking socket 与 epoll，只负责 accept、read/write buffering、flush 和 close callback，不解析 HTTP 方法、header 或 status code。
request parser 通过 http_connection_pop_line 读取 request line 与 headers，并通过 http_connection_pop_bytes 读取 Content-Length 指定的 body。
response bytes 先排入 connection output buffer；如果发送未完成，则通过 EPOLLOUT interest 继续 flush。
所有 response 都带 Connection: close，server 在 pending output 清空后关闭 client fd 并移除 session。

roles.name: client
roles.summary: 外部 HTTP client 建立 TCP connection，发送 HTTP/1.1 request，接收一个 response 后连接关闭。

roles.name: server
roles.summary: 目标实现是 HTTP/1.1 static file server subset，支持 GET、HEAD、POST、目录 index/listing、path sandbox 和固定错误响应。

interaction_units.name: http_request
interaction_units.summary: 由 request line、headers、空行和可选 Content-Length body 组成，解析为 http_request_t。

interaction_units.name: http_response
interaction_units.summary: 由 status line、Date、Server、Content-Length、Connection: close、extra headers、空行和可选 body 组成。

interaction_units.name: filesystem_resource
interaction_units.summary: GET/HEAD/POST 的 URI 映射到 root sandbox 下的文件或目录。

core_flows.name: connection_accept
core_flows.summary: TCP server accept client fd，server_app 创建 http_session_t 并把 fd 加入 session list。

core_flows.name: request_parse
core_flows.summary: readable event 读取 bytes，http_request_parse 解析完整 request；不完整返回 1 并等待更多数据。

core_flows.name: get_file_or_directory
core_flows.summary: GET request 经 dispatch 进入 handle_get/serve_file，安全解析 URI，服务普通文件、目录 index.html 或目录列表。

core_flows.name: head_file_or_directory
core_flows.summary: HEAD 与 GET 共享 serve_file，但 response body 为 NULL，Content-Length 保持目标资源长度。

core_flows.name: post_create_file
core_flows.summary: POST request 必须携带 body；server 在 root sandbox 下以 wb 写入目标文件，成功返回 201 Created。

core_flows.name: error_response
core_flows.summary: parse error、unsupported method、path traversal、missing resource、POST directory 等失败路径生成 HTML error response。

surface_catalog.name: CONNECTION
surface_catalog.summary: Accepted TCP connection with one http_session_t and one http_connection_t.

surface_catalog.name: HTTP_REQUEST
surface_catalog.summary: HTTP/1.1 request parsed from request line, headers and optional Content-Length body.

surface_catalog.name: GET
surface_catalog.summary: Serves a regular file, directory index.html, or generated directory listing with a body.

surface_catalog.name: HEAD
surface_catalog.summary: Uses the GET file-serving path but omits the response body while preserving Content-Length.

surface_catalog.name: POST
surface_catalog.summary: Writes the request body to the requested sandboxed file path and returns 201 on success.

surface_catalog.name: UNKNOWN_METHOD
surface_catalog.summary: Any method other than GET, HEAD or POST maps to HTTP_UNKNOWN and returns 501.

surface_catalog.name: HTTP_RESPONSE
surface_catalog.summary: Normal success response built by http_response_send with status line, standard headers, optional extra headers and optional body.

surface_catalog.name: ERROR_RESPONSE
surface_catalog.summary: HTML error response generated by send_error for supported error status codes.

surface_catalog.name: DIRECTORY_INDEX
surface_catalog.summary: Directory request first tries index.html before generating a listing.

surface_catalog.name: DIRECTORY_LISTING
surface_catalog.summary: When no index.html exists, server generates an HTML directory listing.

message_or_command_entries.name: request_line
message_or_command_entries.syntax_or_layout: METHOD SP URI SP VERSION CRLF
message_or_command_entries.summary: Parser reads one line and requires sscanf to extract method, uri and version tokens.

fields.name: method
fields.summary: GET, HEAD and POST map to public enum values HTTP_GET, HTTP_HEAD and HTTP_POST; all others map to HTTP_UNKNOWN.

fields.name: uri
fields.summary: URI is copied into http_request_t.uri with HTTP_MAX_URI bound.

fields.name: version
fields.summary: Version token is parsed for request-line shape, but current implementation does not validate that it equals HTTP/1.1.

message_or_command_entries.name: headers
message_or_command_entries.syntax_or_layout: repeated Name ':' OWS Value CRLF, terminated by empty line
message_or_command_entries.summary: Parser splits each header on the first colon, trims leading spaces/tabs from value, stores up to HTTP_MAX_HEADERS headers and skips malformed header lines without colon.

fields.name: header_value
fields.summary: Stored in char[HTTP_MAX_HEADER_VALUE] after leading OWS is skipped.

fields.name: Content-Length
fields.summary: Looked up case-insensitively and parsed with strtoul to decide body length.

message_or_command_entries.name: request_body
message_or_command_entries.summary: If Content-Length is present and positive, parser waits until that many bytes are buffered, pops a heap copy, and stores body/body_len.

fields.name: body
fields.summary: Heap-allocated body pointer owned by http_request_t and released by http_request_free.

fields.name: body_len
fields.summary: Equals parsed Content-Length when body is present.

message_or_command_entries.name: response
message_or_command_entries.syntax_or_layout: HTTP/1.1 status reason CRLF headers CRLF optional body
message_or_command_entries.summary: http_response_send emits status line, Date, Server, Content-Length, Connection: close, extra headers, blank line and optional body.

fields.name: Content-Length
fields.summary: Always emitted from the body_len argument, including HEAD where body is NULL but body_len is the resource length.

fields.name: Content-Type
fields.summary: Provided through extra_headers for file, directory listing and HTML error responses.

field_constraints.condition: request line cannot parse into method, URI and version
field_constraints.required_action: http_request_parse returns -1; server returns 400 and closes the connection.
http_request_parse returns 1 and server waits for more bytes.
http_request_parse returns -1; server sends 400 in current source even though specs/README describe 413 as the intended POST size error.

field_constraints.condition: method is not GET, HEAD or POST

field_constraints.required_action: resource resolver fails with errno=EACCES; file-serving path sends 403.

state_nodes.name: accepted_connection
state_nodes.summary: TCP fd is accepted, http_session_t exists, and http_connection_t owns input/output buffers.

state_nodes.name: buffering_request
state_nodes.summary: Input bytes are buffered until request line, headers and any Content-Length body are complete.

state_nodes.name: parsed_request
state_nodes.summary: http_request_parse returned 0 and request fields are ready for method dispatch.

state_nodes.name: response_queued
state_nodes.summary: Handler queued response bytes and registered writable interest if needed.

state_nodes.name: closed_connection
state_nodes.summary: Client fd is closed, removed from epoll and session list, and http_session_t is destroyed.

transitions.summary: Readable event causes http_connection_read to append bytes to the connection buffer.
A complete request is parsed and dispatched by method.
Incomplete request remains buffered until more TCP bytes arrive.

transitions.trigger: GET, HEAD, POST or UNKNOWN dispatch
transitions.summary: Handler queues success or error response and updates writable interest.
Because responses use Connection: close, server closes the fd after response bytes are flushed.

transitions.trigger: TCP EOF, read error, flush error, parse error after 400 response
transitions.summary: Server closes the connection on EOF/error; parse errors send 400 then close.

invariants.summary: server_app must use http_request_parse and http_response_send instead of ad hoc HTTP parsing or response formatting.
server_app must call http_resolve_path before serving or writing filesystem resources.
The runtime does not implement keep-alive, request pipelining reuse, or chunked Transfer-Encoding.

dispatch_keys.name: http_method_t
dispatch_keys.summary: dispatch switches on req->method and routes HTTP_GET, HTTP_HEAD, HTTP_POST and HTTP_UNKNOWN.

dispatch_keys.name: uri_path
dispatch_keys.summary: GET/HEAD/POST use req->uri as the resource path passed through http_resolve_path.

dispatch_keys.name: Content-Length
dispatch_keys.summary: POST body availability and size are determined by parsed Content-Length and buffered body bytes.

dispatch_keys.name: filesystem_type
dispatch_keys.summary: http_stat_path returns 0 regular file, 1 directory, or -1 error to drive file, directory or 404 behavior.

dispatch_targets.name: http_request_parse
dispatch_targets.summary: Protocol parser converts buffered bytes to http_request_t.

dispatch_targets.name: dispatch
dispatch_targets.summary: Server method dispatcher routes GET, HEAD, POST and UNKNOWN.

dispatch_targets.name: http_response_send
dispatch_targets.summary: Protocol response encoder queues final HTTP/1.1 response bytes.

matching_rules.summary: Directory resources first try index.html; only when it is absent does the server generate a directory listing.
MIME type is selected from the resolved file extension and defaults to application/octet-stream.
Header lookup is case-insensitive through http_request_header.

resource_objects.name: http_connection
resource_objects.summary: Owns socket fd, input buffer, output buffer, output offset and dynamic capacities.

resource_objects.name: http_session
resource_objects.summary: Associates an fd with its http_connection_t; created on accept and destroyed on close.

resource_objects.name: http_request
resource_objects.summary: Stores method, URI, headers, header_count, heap body pointer and body_len.

resource_objects.name: server_root
resource_objects.summary: Canonical root directory stored in http_server_t and used as the filesystem sandbox root.

resource_objects.name: static_file
resource_objects.summary: Regular file read fully into a heap buffer and sent with MIME Content-Type.

resource_objects.name: directory_listing
resource_objects.summary: Generated HTML page for directory entries when no index.html exists.

lifecycle_rules.summary: A session is allocated when a client fd is accepted and added to the server session list.
http_request_free releases any heap body after dispatch or parse failure.
File and directory-listing heap buffers are freed after response bytes are queued.
POST write failures unlink the partially written target file before returning 500.
Closing a client fd removes it from epoll and triggers session destruction through on_close.

persistence_scope.name: root_directory_files
persistence_scope.summary: Persistent state is limited to files under the configured root directory; POST may create or overwrite a file at the requested sandboxed path.

persistence_scope.name: no_application_database
persistence_scope.summary: The example has no database, authentication store, CGI runtime, virtual host table or TLS state.

error_matrix.condition: malformed request line or parser error
error_matrix.required_action: send 400 Bad Request, flush/update output, then close connection.

error_matrix.condition: path traversal or resource path outside root sandbox
GET or HEAD target does not exist or is unsupported file type
POST target is an existing directory
POST body is larger than HTTP_MAX_BODY
error_matrix.required_action: intended rule is 413 Payload Too Large, but current parser returns -1 and server_event maps parse errors to 400.

error_matrix.condition: file read, directory listing, POST write, response formatting or allocation fails
error_matrix.required_action: send 500 Internal Server Error where handler can recover.

recommended_values.name: validation_profile
recommended_values.value_or_rule: Use curl to exercise GET, HEAD, POST create, directory listing, traversal rejection, POST directory rejection and unsupported method.

hard_bounds.name: read_chunk
hard_bounds.value_or_rule: http_connection_read uses 4096-byte recv chunks and grows input buffer dynamically.

hard_bounds.name: response_format_buffer
hard_bounds.value_or_rule: queuefv formats individual header lines into a 4096-byte stack buffer.

hard_bounds.name: directory_segment_count
hard_bounds.value_or_rule: http_resolve_path stores up to 256 path segments while normalizing URI paths.

configurable_bounds.name: listen_port
configurable_bounds.value_or_rule: main accepts argv[1] port in range 1..65535.

configurable_bounds.name: root_directory
configurable_bounds.value_or_rule: main accepts argv[2] root; http_server_create requires realpath(root) to exist and be a directory.

security.name: path_sandbox
security.summary: All resource paths must pass http_resolve_path root-prefix validation before file service or POST write.

security.name: tls
security.summary: TLS/HTTPS is outside current scope; transport is plain TCP.

security.name: authentication
security.summary: Authentication and authorization are outside current scope.

must_support_surface.name: CONNECTION
must_support_surface.summary: Accept TCP clients through epoll runtime and create one session per fd.

must_support_surface.name: HTTP_REQUEST
must_support_surface.summary: Parse request line, headers and optional Content-Length body from connection buffer.

must_support_surface.name: GET
must_support_surface.summary: Serve static files, index.html for directories, or generated directory listings.

must_support_surface.name: HEAD
must_support_surface.summary: Serve GET-equivalent headers and Content-Length without response body.

must_support_surface.name: POST
must_support_surface.summary: Write non-empty request body to a sandboxed filesystem path and return 201 Created.

must_support_surface.name: HTTP_RESPONSE
must_support_surface.summary: Encode HTTP/1.1 responses with Content-Length and Connection: close.

must_support_surface.name: ERROR_RESPONSE
must_support_surface.summary: Return expected error responses for malformed request, traversal, not found, method not allowed, unsupported method and internal failures.

must_support_surface.name: DIRECTORY_LISTING
must_support_surface.summary: Generate HTML directory listing when index.html is absent.

must_support_surface.name: UNKNOWN_METHOD
must_support_surface.summary: Return 501 for methods outside GET, HEAD and POST.

must_support_state_behaviors.name: session_lifecycle
must_support_state_behaviors.summary: Create http_session_t on accept and destroy it on close callback.

must_support_state_behaviors.name: incremental_request_buffering
must_support_state_behaviors.summary: Return to event loop when request is incomplete and preserve buffered bytes.

must_support_state_behaviors.name: close_after_response
must_support_state_behaviors.summary: Close connection after response data has been fully flushed.

must_support_state_behaviors.name: resource_sandbox_before_io
must_support_state_behaviors.summary: Resolve and validate URI under root before read, listing or write.

must_support_error_paths.name: post_directory
must_support_error_paths.summary: POST to an existing directory produces 405.

must_support_limits.name: request_size_bounds
must_support_limits.summary: Honor HTTP_MAX_HEADERS, URI/header buffer sizes and HTTP_MAX_BODY.

must_support_limits.name: root_sandbox
must_support_limits.summary: Reject filesystem paths that escape the configured root directory.

must_support_limits.name: method_subset
must_support_limits.summary: Only GET, HEAD and POST are in scope.

may_defer_features.name: keep_alive_and_pipelining
may_defer_features.summary: Persistent connections and pipelining are not supported.

may_defer_features.name: chunked_transfer_encoding
may_defer_features.summary: Chunked request or response transfer encoding is outside scope.

may_defer_features.name: range_and_conditional_requests
may_defer_features.summary: Range, If-Modified-Since, ETag and related conditional request behavior are outside scope.

may_defer_features.name: tls_virtual_hosts_authentication_cgi
may_defer_features.summary: TLS/HTTPS, virtual hosts, authentication and CGI/server-side scripting are outside scope.

implementation_assumptions.name: server_only_target
implementation_assumptions.summary: Downstream coder agent should generate server-side HTTP code; clients are external curl-like tools.

implementation_assumptions.name: module_boundaries
implementation_assumptions.summary: Keep HTTP parsing/response encoding in protocol, path and file logic in resource, and socket IO in network.

implementation_assumptions.name: plain_tcp_static_file_server
implementation_assumptions.summary: The runtime is a single-process epoll static file server over plain TCP.

planning_inputs.protocol_summary: HTTP/1.1 server subset implemented in C over plain TCP + epoll. The planning target is a static file server that parses request line/headers/Content-Length body, supports GET, HEAD and POST, serves files or directory listings under a root sandbox, writes POST bodies to files, sends Content-Length responses with Connection: close, and intentionally defers keep-alive, pipelining, chunked transfer, range/conditional requests, TLS, virtual hosts, CGI and authentication.
planning_checklist: 报文模型与编解码范围
required_codec_scope: HTTP/1.1 response generation with Date, Server, Content-Length and Connection: close
critical_stateful_behaviors: One session is tied to one accepted fd.
Incomplete requests remain buffered until enough bytes arrive.
Dispatch occurs only after http_request_parse returns a complete request.
Response output is flushed before the connection is closed.
URI paths must be resolved inside root before filesystem IO.
error_handling_obligations: Return 405 for POST to existing directories.
Record the 413-vs-400 oversized-body mismatch as an implementation risk.
persistence_and_lifecycle_obligations: Canonicalize and validate root at server creation.
Free file/listing buffers after queuing responses.
Close and remove sessions after response flush.
POST writes persist under root directory.
implementation_risks: Spec rule C7 says oversized POST body should return 413, but current parser returns -1 and on_event_cb maps parse errors to 400.
Request version is parsed but not validated, so non-HTTP/1.1 versions may still be accepted.
Malformed header lines without ':' are skipped instead of causing 400.
POST opens the target with wb, so it can overwrite an existing regular file despite the summary wording that POST creates files.
The event loop attempts to process all complete requests in the buffer, but Connection: close means downstream specs should not advertise pipelining support.
consistency_findings: README, SUMMARY and module spec agree on GET/HEAD/POST, default port 8080, static file serving, directory listing, POST write and Connection: close.
Forbidden symbols match the public API names in headers: HTTP_GET/HTTP_POST, http_response_send, http_mime_by_ext, and explicit pop_line/pop_bytes functions.
Module boundaries are explicit: network handles bytes/events, protocol handles HTTP parse/encode, resource handles filesystem sandbox and file operations.

open_questions.question: Should oversized Content-Length preserve current source behavior as 400 parse error, or should the implementation/specs be repaired to return 413 Payload Too Large as documented by C7 and README?
open_questions.suggested_followup: For exact parity with protocol-example/http, keep 400; for spec consistency, update parser/server to distinguish oversized body from generic parse error.

open_questions.question: Should request version be validated as HTTP/1.1, or remain parsed-but-ignored as in current source?
open_questions.suggested_followup: Keep parsed-only in gold facts unless stabilization explicitly adds version validation.

open_questions.question: Should POST be create-only and reject existing regular files, or preserve current wb overwrite behavior?
open_questions.suggested_followup: Decide whether C7's create-only wording should drive a code/spec repair, because current source only rejects existing directories.

evidence_index.excerpt: SUMMARY defines HTTP/1.1 server subset, SERVER role, default port 8080, and GET/HEAD/POST validation by external clients.
Rules separate network/protocol/resource/server_app responsibilities, require Connection: close, limit methods to GET/HEAD/POST, require directory index priority and define POST bounds.
Forbidden symbols call out incorrect enum/function names such as HTTP_METHOD_GET, http_send_response, http_get_mime and generic http_connection_pop.
README lists epoll TCP server, GET/HEAD/POST, static file serving, directory listing, index.html, POST writes, root sandbox, status codes and Connection: close.
README excludes persistent connections, chunked transfer encoding, range requests, conditional requests, CGI, TLS, virtual hosts and authentication.
README validation uses curl for GET root, GET file, HEAD no body, 404, POST create, POST verify, directory listing, path traversal, POST directory and unknown method.
main defaults to port 8080 and root '.', accepts optional port/root arguments, creates, starts and runs http_server.
Connection code reads recv chunks into input buffer, pops LF-delimited lines, pops exact byte counts, queues output bytes and flushes with send.
TCP server creates nonblocking listener, accepts clients into epoll, dispatches readable/writable app events and closes clients through callbacks.
Header defines HTTP_GET, HTTP_HEAD, HTTP_POST, HTTP_UNKNOWN, HTTP_MAX_HEADERS, HTTP_MAX_URI, HTTP_MAX_HEADER_NAME, HTTP_MAX_HEADER_VALUE, HTTP_MAX_BODY and http_request_t.
Parser reads request line, maps method, stores URI, parses headers, looks up Content-Length, enforces HTTP_MAX_BODY and pops body bytes when available.
Response encoder maps status text, queues HTTP/1.1 status line, Date, Server, Content-Length, Connection: close, extra headers, blank line and body.

evidence_index.section_hint: path, MIME, file and directory helpers
evidence_index.excerpt: Resource helpers map MIME by extension, resolve URI paths under root, stat regular files/directories, read files and generate HTML directory listings.
http_session_t stores fd and http_connection_t pointer; session create/destroy allocate and free the connection object.
http_server_create realpath-validates root_dir, requires it to be a directory, stores canonical root and installs TCP callbacks.
Event callback flushes writable output, reads input, loops over complete requests, handles incomplete/parse-error returns, dispatches requests and closes after response flush.
dispatch routes HTTP_GET to handle_get, HTTP_HEAD to handle_head, HTTP_POST to handle_post, and HTTP_UNKNOWN/default to 501.
serve_file resolves URI, returns 403 on resolve failure, 404 on stat failure, serves index.html for directories, otherwise directory listing or regular file.
handle_post requires non-empty body, resolves path, rejects existing directories with 405, writes body with fopen wb/fwrite, unlinks partial write and returns 201 on success.
Function spec states http_request_parse returns 0 on success, 1 for incomplete request and -1 for parsing/protocol error.
Function spec states response generation queues status line, Date, Server, Content-Length, Connection: close, extra headers, blank line and optional body.
Function spec states http_resolve_path normalizes dot segments, realpath-validates under root and sets errno=EACCES for traversal.
Function spec describes resolve_path, stat, regular file read/send, directory index.html priority and directory listing generation.
Function spec describes POST resolving target path, rejecting directories with 405, writing body using fopen wb/fwrite and sending 201 Created.
Function spec states dispatch routes GET to handle_get, HEAD to handle_head, POST to handle_post and UNKNOWN to 501.
